comments.author: @deeobrien5417
comments.text: Ah the original actual trailer! (I hate when you try to find original trailers and all you can see is those fan made ones) Amazing! I remember when this premiered on Irish tv, I’m pretty sure it was still actually about Halloween (such a great way to start a zombie series right on Halloween, very smart!) and just being enthralled by it. My boyfriend at the time was not into it but totally became hooked and would watch it ahead of me if I wasn’t up in Dublin on time. Those first good few seasons were just terrific, I know some people weren’t into the second season but I think one of the best episodes of the show ever was when Sophia walked out of that barn. I had no idea that would happen and it was absolutely shocking. Also in that whole thing Shane was so  gung-ho about killing all those walkers whivh were Hershel’s people but as soon as the little girl who was one of their people of course everyone was too shocked so despite all their bravado Rick was the one who had to step up and end her, that’s why he was their leader. That show never was the same with Rick, it really lacked that one constant uniting force…
